question: Add the term sparql to the interface vocabulary (interface[] in the record schema)?
why: A SPARQL endpoint is reached with a SPARQL 1.1 protocol client, which neither rest nor graphql names; the Wikidata Query Service at query.wikidata.org/sparql is filed under rest with the true access named in interface_detail, and storage/nakala lists SPARQL among its API surfaces. Two records need it; recommend adding sparql.
